PART VII.  OTHER MEMBER SERVICES

 

     §412:10-700  Insurance for members.  A credit union may purchase or make available insurance for its members either on an individual or group basis. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]

 

Cross References

 

  Group life insurance for credit union groups, see §431:10D-211.
